MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot and Echo Show 8 feel useful because hands-free Alexa control would complement my Fire TV devices and connected-home setup.",
    "The Smart Plug feels like a practical next step because it would add control to a lamp or appliance I already own."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The tablets offer portable entertainment, but my recent purchases have focused on watching television and using cameras at home; I have no clear tablet need right now.",
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television.",
    "Several Alexa devices interest me, but I would choose the Echo Dot and larger Show 8 before adding similar speakers or a smaller display."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Fire TV products seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Interest in connected-home devices seems to have been treated as a reason to buy several overlapping versions."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a new device should add a useful capability beyond my existing television and streaming equipment.",
    "My current interest is in making my home setup more useful, rather than adding portable screens.",
    "An item can fit my interests without being something I would choose now; I prefer selecting one useful option over buying several similar devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in connected-home entertainment, but stretched it into portable devices and overlapping products that add little to my current setup."
}
